name: Georgia

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and red, with a blue canton spanning the top two stripes that holds a ring of 13 white stars around the gold state arms and the words IN GOD WE TRUST.
flag.symbolism: The arch of the arms stands for the constitution and its three pillars for wisdom, justice and moderation; the 13 stars show that Georgia was one of the original colonies.

hook: Georgia is red-white-red with a blue corner in which 13 stars circle a gold arch on three pillars.
trivia: The 2003 flag replaced a 2001 design, which had in turn replaced the 1956 flag dominated by the Confederate battle emblem.
Voters endorsed the current flag in a 2004 referendum.
